scenarios.name: real tmux promotes one idle GJC row to indexed structured history after first input
real tmux resolves Bun and npm-shim GJC wrappers to actionable lineage rows
real tmux preserves pre-existing agents across fresh discovery processes and targets input exactly
real tmux external monitor notifies once per observed Codex turn and rebaselines restarts
real tmux treats two agents in one session as independent pane targets
real tmux rejects stale generation input and termination after same-name recreation
real tmux rejects stale process generations after respawning the same pane
scenarios.detail: stale generation drives the real sendToTmuxPane/killTmuxPane composition, is refused with TMUX_PROCESS_GENERATION_MISMATCH (409), capture-pane bytes are identical before and after each rejection, the replacement agent PID and tmux session survive, and the current generation then succeeds

note: Suite skips itself when tmux is unavailable; this run executed against tmux 3.2a on Linux x86_64.
